verdict.rationale: The pack documents no Fastmail export feature: nothing on bulk export, downloadable archives, or export formats such as mbox, vCard or iCalendar, and no account-departure workflow. Fastmail's support for open protocols (JMAP replacing IMAP/CardDAV/CalDAV, plus API tokens) is a developer building block for building your own export, not an export capability itself. The migration evidence covers importing into Fastmail, not leaving it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
